label: Video Games
description: 80 games — from all-time greats to the ones buried in a desert.

items.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
items.note: For years, the highest-rated game ever made.

items.name: Tetris
items.note: The one game everyone on Earth has played.

items.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
Super Mario 64
items.note: Invented the 3D platformer camera and the modern speedrun.

items.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
items.note: Re-released on approximately every device with a screen.

items.name: Minecraft
items.note: Best-selling video game of all time.

items.name: Doom
items.note: It runs on your fridge, your calculator, and possibly your pregnancy test.

items.name: Dark Souls
items.note: Invented an entire genre and a thousand 'git gud' comments.

items.name: God of War
items.note: Boy.

items.name: BioShock
items.note: Would you kindly.

items.name: Super Smash Bros. Melee
items.note: A 20-year-old party game that became an esport by force of will.

items.name: Stardew Valley
items.note: One guy, four years, your entire winter gone.

items.name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
Disco Elysium
items.note: An RPG with no combat and the best writing in the medium.

items.name: StarCraft
items.note: A national sport in South Korea. Literally.

items.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
items.note: Sold 45 million copies to people trapped indoors in 2020.

items.name: Death Stranding
items.note: A walking-and-delivering simulator by a genius. You've decided already.

items.name: Kingdom Hearts
items.note: Final Fantasy meets Disney. The plot has never once made sense.

items.name: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty
items.note: Bait-and-switched an entire fanbase and was decades ahead of it.

items.name: Shadow of the Colossus
items.note: Is it a game or a moving painting? Yes.

items.name: EarthBound
items.note: Flopped in the West, then became a religion.

items.name: No Man's Sky
items.note: The most infamous launch-then-redemption story in gaming.

items.name: Cyberpunk 2077
items.note: Shipped on fire, patched into greatness. Still starts fights.

items.name: Nier: Automata
items.note: You have to beat it five times to 'get' it, and people did.

items.name: Katamari Damacy
items.note: You roll a sticky ball over the whole planet. It rules.

items.name: Deadly Premonition
items.note: So broken it looped back to beloved.

items.name: Pathologic
items.note: Deliberately miserable. Its fans call that a feature.

items.name: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy
items.note: A man in a pot with a hammer, designed to hurt you.

items.name: Dwarf Fortress
items.note: Losing is fun. The graphics are ASCII. It's a masterpiece.

items.name: Spec Ops: The Line
items.note: A shooter that hates that you're playing a shooter.

items.name: Final Fantasy VIII
items.note: The junction system: loved by nobody, defended by dozens.

items.name: Metroid: Other M
items.note: How to make a Metroid fanbase revolt in one game.

items.name: Dark Souls II
items.note: The Souls game Souls fans argue about.

items.name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
items.note: Landfilled in a New Mexico desert. Archaeologists dug it up.

items.name: Superman 64
items.note: Fly through the rings. Just fly through the rings. Please.

items.name: Big Rigs: Over the Road Racing
items.note: YOU'RE WINNER. The AI never moves. There is no collision.

items.name: Sonic the Hedgehog (2006)
items.note: The one where Sonic kisses a human princess. It's a lot.

items.name: Bubsy 3D
items.note: What could possibly go wrong?

items.name: Aliens: Colonial Marines
items.note: A single typo in the code reportedly broke the alien AI for years.

items.name: Fallout 76
items.note: The canvas-bag-and-nylon-nuka-cola launch of legend.

items.name: Duke Nukem Forever
items.note: 15 years in development. Should have stayed there.

items.name: Goat Simulator
items.note: Intentionally broken. That's the joke, and it works.

items.name: Flappy Bird
items.note: So maddening the creator pulled it from the store himself.

items.name: Anthem
items.note: Beautiful flying, attached to nothing. Abandoned within a year.
